data.one_liner: Crypto wallet package for Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron written in pure Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for generating BIP39 mnemonics, handling keys, and creating or validating addresses for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron blockchains in pure Dart.
use_when: You need to generate or parse cryptocurrency wallet addresses and keys in pure Dart.
You are working with Bitcoin, Ethereum, or Tron blockchains and need address validation or signature generation.
avoid_when: You need a comprehensive Web3 provider library with smart contract interaction out of the box.
You require support for blockchains other than Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron.
strengths: Written in pure Dart, ensuring cross-platform support including web and mobile.
Supports multiple popular blockchains like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron.
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to heavy Web3 suites.
Not documented for complex RPC interactions or full smart contract execution.

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick web3dart if you need robust Ethereum blockchain interaction, RPC client capabilities, and smart contract execution.
